reviews.title: Noctua is the best for a reason
reviews.comment: Noctua is the best for a reason, quiet, and the best at moving air. Needed a usb option for a mini rack build and this is the perfect solution! Highest quality! You get what you pay for when it comes to these fans.
reviews.author: Bradley Dormanen

reviews.title: Great fan if you pair with a speed controller.
reviews.comment: Used this to upgrade a lesser quality fan in a cabinet to cut down on noise. If you want it silent, you will need something to adjust speed: Some RPM's are quieter than others and it's not linear. Definitely moves lots of air silently when tuned to the right speed.
reviews.author: Mark S Larner

reviews.title: Good fan
reviews.comment: Still running great non-stop years later.  Not too loud but not very quiet as one can expect.
reviews.author: Oliver

reviews.title: Silent fan moves air.
reviews.comment: Moves air and is silent just what I was looking for. Installed in power supply for a antminer.
reviews.author: Sunburstkisses

reviews.title: Nice fans
reviews.comment: Very quiet and a nice upgrade to our Xbox X
